caption: The drawing consists of two separate rectangular sections, both set against a cream-colored background. The larger vertical section on the right features a pinkish background with a repetitive decorative motif. The motif is composed of a series of red starburst or floral shapes arranged vertically, each surrounded by curved garlands of greenish-blue leaves, forming almost circular patterns around the red centers. Fine cracks are visible throughout this section, suggesting an aged or weathered surface. To the left, a smaller vertical strip displays a border design. This strip, also with a pinkish background, contains a repeating pattern of red circular flowers, each circled by radiating greenish-blue leaves. To the far left of this smaller strip, a raised edge or molding is depicted in soft brown and pink tones, separating the border design from the edge of the drawing. There are no human figures or animals, and the focus is entirely on the decorative botanical patterns and the soft, muted color palette.
title: Wall Stencil
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
